reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Wisconsin
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Does the law require the landlord to give the tenant notice to vacate
    the property prior to terminating a tenancy?

    This program encodes (a) relevant WI statutes and (b) a simple factual scenario,
    then derives yes/no from those rules.
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question's factual statement)
% -----------------------------

% Jurisdiction / time
scenario_state(wisconsin).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% Parties
landlord(landlord1).
tenant(tenant1).

% Tenancy facts for this question scenario:
% We model a common case: landlord wants to terminate a month-to-month (periodic) tenancy,
% not because of breach/criminal activity, and no special exceptions apply.
tenancy_type(tenant1, periodic).
periodic_basis(tenant1, month_to_month).
rent_payable_basis(tenant1, monthly).

termination_attempt(landlord1, tenant1).
termination_reason(landlord1, tenant1, no_fault_end_of_period).

% Exceptions in WI Stat  704.19(2)(a): none apply in this scenario.
express_other_termination_method_agreed(landlord1, tenant1) :- fail.
surrender_of_premises_effected(tenant1) :- fail.
tenant_vacated_without_notice_and_failed_to_pay_rent(tenant1) :- fail.

% A helper predicate that succeeds when the scenario (as encoded) holds.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(wisconsin),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    landlord(L),
    tenant(T),
    tenancy_type(T, periodic),
    periodic_basis(T, month_to_month),
    termination_attempt(L, T),
    termination_reason(L, T, no_fault_end_of_period),
    \+ express_other_termination_method_agreed(L, T),
    \+ surrender_of_premises_effected(T),
    \+ tenant_vacated_without_notice_and_failed_to_pay_rent(T).

% -----------------------------
% Common notice concepts (minimal encoding of "notice in writing" etc.)
% -----------------------------

% We treat "notice" as a required action type; we do not simulate actual service mechanics.
notice_form(written).
notice_manner(complies_with_704_21).

% -----------------------------
% Statute encodings
% -----------------------------

/* WI Stat  704.19 (2021) - Notice necessary to terminate periodic tenancies and tenancies at will.
   Key rule used here:
   - A periodic tenancy or tenancy at will can be terminated by either landlord or tenant
     only by giving written notice complying with this section, unless an exception applies.
   - Length: at least 28 days (for monthly rent/pay periods), with special rules for shorter rent periods.
*/

% Covered tenancy types for 704.19 scope.
statute_704_19_subject_tenancy_type(periodic).
statute_704_19_subject_tenancy_type(at_will).

% Exceptions under  704.19(2)(a) and (6).
statute_704_19_exception_applies(Landlord, Tenant) :-
    express_other_termination_method_agreed(Landlord, Tenant),
    !.
statute_704_19_exception_applies(_Landlord, Tenant) :-
    surrender_of_premises_effected(Tenant),
    !.
statute_704_19_exception_applies(_Landlord, Tenant) :-
    tenant_vacated_without_notice_and_failed_to_pay_rent(Tenant),
    !.
statute_704_19_exception_applies(_Landlord, _Tenant) :-
    fail.

% Notice length under  704.19(3).
% - At least 28 days except: if rent payable less than monthly, notice at least equal to rent-paying period.
statute_704_19_required_notice_days(Tenant, Days) :-
    rent_payable_basis(Tenant, monthly),
    Days = 28,
    !.
statute_704_19_required_notice_days(Tenant, Days) :-
    rent_payable_basis(Tenant, weekly),
    Days = 7,
    !.
statute_704_19_required_notice_days(Tenant, Days) :-
    rent_payable_basis(Tenant, daily),
    Days = 1,
    !.
statute_704_19_required_notice_days(_Tenant, 28) :-
    % Default fallback consistent with "at least 28 days" for most periodic tenancies.
    !.

% Core duty: notice required to terminate periodic/at-will tenancy (unless exception).
statute_704_19_notice_required(Landlord, Tenant, written_notice(Days, written, complies_with_704_21)) :-
    statute_704_19_subject_tenancy_type(Type),
    tenancy_type(Tenant, Type),
    \+ statute_704_19_exception_applies(Landlord, Tenant),
    statute_704_19_required_notice_days(Tenant, Days).

/* WI Stat  704.16(3)(b)3 (2021) - Termination by landlord for imminent threat (offending tenant).
   - Landlord may terminate if conditions met AND landlord gives written notice requiring vacate
     at least 5 days after giving notice (complies with 704.21).
   We encode the "notice required" part with the 5-day threshold.
*/

statute_704_16_landlord_notice_required(_Landlord, _Tenant, written_notice(5, written, complies_with_704_21)) :-
    % We do not assert the threat/offender prerequisites in this generic scenario,
    % but the statute is encoded for completeness.
    true.

/* WI Stat  704.17(2021) - Notice terminating tenancies for failure to pay rent or other breach.
   Key points used here:
   - For certain breaches/nonpayment/criminal activity/nuisance, termination requires written notice
     given as specified in 704.21, with varying minimum days (often 5/14/30).
   We encode the "notice required" structure and representative day thresholds.
*/

% We model a few common 704.17 notice categories sufficient to answer the notice question.
% Month-to-month / week-to-week nonpayment: 5-day pay-or-vacate OR 14-day vacate (while in default).
statute_704_17_notice_required(_Landlord, Tenant, nonpayment_rent, written_notice(5, written, complies_with_704_21)) :-
    tenancy_type(Tenant, periodic),
    periodic_basis(Tenant, month_to_month),
    !.
statute_704_17_notice_required(_Landlord, Tenant, nonpayment_rent, written_notice(14, written, complies_with_704_21)) :-
    tenancy_type(Tenant, periodic),
    periodic_basis(Tenant, month_to_month),
    !.

% Criminal activity: at least 5-day notice to vacate.
statute_704_17_notice_required(_Landlord, _Tenant, criminal_activity_or_drug_related, written_notice(5, written, complies_with_704_21)) :-
    !.

% Lease > 1 year: generally 30-day notice to cure/comply (for rent, waste, or other breach).
statute_704_17_notice_required(_Landlord, Tenant, breach_or_nonpayment_under_lease_more_than_one_year, written_notice(30, written, complies_with_704_21)) :-
    tenancy_type(Tenant, lease_more_than_one_year),
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Legal reasoning: Is notice required (in general) for this scenario?
% -----------------------------

% For this question, we ask whether the law requires the landlord to give notice to vacate
% prior to terminating the tenancy in the scenario.
legal_notice_required(Landlord, Tenant, Notice) :-
    % Primary rule for no-fault termination of periodic tenancy:  704.19.
    termination_reason(Landlord, Tenant, no_fault_end_of_period),
    statute_704_19_notice_required(Landlord, Tenant, Notice),
    !.
legal_notice_required(Landlord, Tenant, Notice) :-
    % If termination is for breach/nonpayment/criminal activity,  704.17 requires written notice.
    termination_reason(Landlord, Tenant, Reason),
    ( Reason = nonpayment_rent
    ; Reason = breach
    ; Reason = nuisance
    ; Reason = criminal_activity_or_drug_related
    ),
    statute_704_17_notice_required(Landlord, Tenant, Reason, Notice),
    !.
legal_notice_required(Landlord, Tenant, Notice) :-
    % If termination is for imminent threat by an offending tenant,  704.16(3) requires notice.
    termination_reason(Landlord, Tenant, imminent_threat_offending_tenant),
    statute_704_16_landlord_notice_required(Landlord, Tenant, Notice),
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Answer predicate
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    landlord(L),
    tenant(T),
    legal_notice_required(L, T, _Notice),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint (REQUIRED)
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law require the landlord to give the tenant notice to vacate the property prior to terminating a tenancy?
